notes.title: Engine Update
notes.content:
Hey, 

Today we have brought you a maintenance update. 
- We updated the game engine, so now the game should also work just fine on Wind 11. Previously, some user experienced game crashes on Win 11. 
-Also, we fixed a small bug that sometimes caused some players to not see the full date contents for Paris and Reia. 
- Added new games carousel.

notes.title: Ruby Update

Hello fellow pervs,

We have released "Ruby Update", a major content update that brings you a new girl, Ruby, a hot threesome date and, as an experiment, Voice Acting ( for now only available during Ruby's Date ). If the response is positive, we will add voice acting to the older and new dates In the future. 

To access any follow-up dates with a girl, check her options on the Tablet. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41511906/650e814d1d5e17cad12dfc2201802ba649d38c8c.png

So, 2 dates, over 350 renders, more massages, new drinks, voices, and the story is going forward.

Also, we added a "Text Speed" setting to controll the text-type speed and a "Voices Volume" setting to control the volume of the voices in the game. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

This is just a quick update regarding the development of Perfect Date. 

Initially, I wanted to release an update before St's Valentine ( 14/02/2022 ). The update was meant to be around 150 renders, and include a new character. 
But, while talking with some players who have requested the addition of voice, I have started looking for a good VA, one that would bring the quality needed to make this project a really hot one. 

I have found her so I decided to postpone the update a bit, so I could include some of the audio lines for the new character too. 

So, the next update will take place probably in 2 weeks, it will contain 1 new girl, Ruby, it will contain the audio for at least 1 date ( Rubby's ) and it will contain 1 Threesome Date. Ruby and Parris. So far there are around 300 renders done and  I plan to add a few more. 

These are just some teasers from the coming update.
